Question 17

A=[286−2145−3−2−5−38−1−1−41],B=[20−441000−2372−131−2]

Consider the matrices A and B above. By applying three matrix elementary column operations

  1. C2:=…
  2. C3:=C3−5C1
  3. C4:=…
each of the form Ci:=Ci+kC1, the matrix A can be transformed into the matrix B. What are the missing elementary column operations?

a
C2:=C2−2C1 and C4:=C4+3C1
b
C2:=C2−3C1 and C4:=C4+4C1
c
C2:=C2−4C1 and C4:=C4−3C1
d
C2:=C2+4C1 and C4:=C4+3C1
e
C2:=C2−4C1 and C4:=C4+3C1
